scope: Compare existing 15/306 first; at most one source-method left candidate and one native 5750-step left regression. No right full rollout.

benchmark.controls: Exact next recorded 13D MuJoCo ctrl sequence, open-loop playback for cost isolation, NOT a new controller or native policy counterfactual.
benchmark.initialization: Same saved qpos/qvel/time per A/B; qacc_warmstart starts zero; static forward outside timer. No saved complete integration-state equality claim.
benchmark.timing: perf_counter_ns around mj_step only; compile/forward/ctrl assignment/contact reads/serialization measured separately or excluded.
benchmark.health_stop: nonfinite, MuJoCo warning, nonmonotonic/wrong timestep; abort affected playback and preserve its first cause; no tuned retry.
benchmark.inference_limit: Short open-loop cost/control perturbation only; no new functional-grasp claim.

candidate_condition: Clear relevant collision-quality benefit and no unacceptable measured cost; reconstruct from original source-feature build method, not copy opposite delivered OBJ. Preserve all nonwrist fields.
functional_protocol: Frozen native left LIBERO diagnostic, original 230 actions, Reset, controller, stopping bounds, native/strict semantics unchanged. Numerical/geometry/candidate preflight must pass.
selection: Consider geometric quality, false/abnormal contacts, measured J6 effects, historical and newly executed grasp evidence, measured step cost. Keep current defaults absent task-level evidence justifying replacement.
